children: said on Monday it would host a "Pro and tell" event in Los Angeles on October 28, the latest in a series of product launches as the iPhone maker expands its hardware lineup and AI offerings.
The event is expected to feature Apple's first touch-screen MacBook Pro, according to Bloomberg News, a long-awaited change to the Mac lineup.
The event follows Apple's September launch of the Duo foldable iPhone and last week's unveiling of the HomeView smart-home hub and other Siri-powered home devices
It comes amid efforts by chief executive John Ternus to speed up product development and simplify the company's structure, according to analysts
Apple typically holds an annual developers conference focused on software in June, and often conducts fall events centered on iPhones and other consumer devices
